end.summary:
Identified examples of observations, hypotheses, and laws with prompting.
Suggested an investigation comparing salt water and plain water boiling temperatures.
Used “why it happens” and gravity as theory-related examples, but needed clarification.
Theories turning into laws was stated as a misconception and was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised distinguishing observations, hypotheses, laws, and theories through examples and a salt-water investigation. Tara formed a testable hypothesis and identified variables such as the temperatures of both liquids. The mix-up that theories turn into laws when proven was still present at the end. At home, ask Tara to sort examples into observation, hypothesis, law, or theory and explain why a scientific theory does not turn into a law.
